laws: Intent meaning is bound to a canonical JSON digest before durable admission.
Every mutation derives an immutable candidate and publishes live state only after durable save or exact disk reconciliation.
Pre-publish failures preserve the durable pre-call state; ambiguous post-publish failures reload the exact durable result.
All handles for one canonical directory serialize mutations and refresh from disk within the current process.
Duplicate execution, duplicate publication, conflicting intent meaning and orphan effects are typed refusals.
Torn final JSONL records are durable truncation points and interior corruption fails closed.
Returned outcome and effect-detail snapshots are deep-cloned and deeply immutable.
Replay digests are deterministic over the exact durable inbox and outbox records.

outcomeMatrix.outcome: historical optional transactional inbox/outbox implementation and PR delivery
durable failure reconciliation, same-process multi-handle serialization and immutable public snapshots
negative, crash, Unicode and implementation-mutant coverage

cross-process serialization, byte bound and compaction

residualRisks: Cross-process or cross-host writers are not serialized by the process-local canonical-directory queue.
Inbox execution and outbox effect staging are individually durable transitions, not one atomic composite transaction.
The production composition root does not attach this optional internal API or automatically stage external effects.
External delivery is at-least-once unless the effect sink independently deduplicates by effectId.
A landed project commit whose later execution mark fails is visible but has no automatic exact-marker recovery path in this contour.
Log byte-size bounding and compaction are not certified by the R4 oracle.
